answer: Start from the forger's budget and work backwards. Dietitian registration with health council attestation sets the unit price at four-year degree, 1,200 supervised practice hours, exam, annual renewal. The anchor is the asymmetry: the checker spends seconds and nothing, while the faker spends years and a fortune. One imitation is affordable; a thousand are a business that loses money on every unit, and the jetty in each unit is a person doing ordinary work in the ordinary world. The pearl is the trail — it remembers every payment, every visit, every signature.
